about: Actions the Mac may finish without a tap. Chosen by Cassidy on 2026-11-09. Set a value to false to turn it off; the item then comes to him as one tap. Only cos-obligations reads this, and only cos-sched runs it. Nov 19 (Cassidy said yes to all four in Claude Code): own_card_daily_log (his daily logs on his own cards) and dictated_comments_own_cards (a comment he dictated word for word, on his own card), read by cos-gh log|comment; roadmap_blank_fills (sheet cells that are blank today, filled from the board, need no yes; the preview marks them), bot_created_docs (Bots edit Google Docs they created without asking; a Grok Custom Rule). Each is listed in the evening brief with its undo.
